brief.zh: a 说：「b 是无赖。」b 说：「我们俩都是骑士。」把两人的话译成逻辑，接成电路：两人的话都和身份相符的行，输出真。
brief.en: a says: “b is a knave.” b says: “We are both knights.” Translate what both say into logic and wire it: the board outputs true on exactly the rows where what each says fits what they are.

hint.en: Translate what each person says on its own.
